punchline: British Cycling's new coach hired a surgeon to teach riders hand-washing and had the team truck painted white.
thirty_sec: In 2003, British Cycling had won a single Olympic gold since 1908. Its new performance director, Dave Brailsford, skipped the big fix and looked for 1 percent gains everywhere: comfier seats, grippier tires, the right pillow for each rider, a surgeon teaching hand-washing, a white truck interior to show dust. Five years later, in Beijing, the team won roughly 60 percent of the cycling golds on offer.
question: What is one small detail in your routine that you have never really looked at, but might be worth 1 percent?
